text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days have passed since the
festival in Oi. As I approach the
school gates for
another day of work, I spot a familiar
figure.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh, so if the school gates are
here—Wh-whoa! It's you again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, in the flesh. Uhhh,
didn't expect to
get found out like this,
but ya see...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, for real?! Yeah, I'd really appreciate it! Hehe... now you can see what it's like to show 'round the newcomer.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wow... I'd heard the rumors, but I wasn't
expecting dorms, the gym, and the
cafeteria to be so gigantic... even this
training track is
huuuge!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Guess everything really is bigger at Tracen. And I'm not just talkin' 'bout the buildings...

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(A partner run, huh? And they're in the
homestretch... right 'round the
time where
ya figure out when to make your move.)

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Now! Hraaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, already?! It's a li'l early,
don'tcha
think?)

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: ...No. Not yet!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, fine. In that case...
I'll just outrun you!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Grrraaaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
I see. Since your final spurt needs work,
you tried to trick your opponent into
starting their spurt sooner,
thus turning it into a battle
of endurance. Good thinking!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
In that case,
let's focus on increasing your
stamina—both in class and
on your own.
Now, as for you...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on seeing through her trick! You
kept calm and saved your energy for the
final push.
Now all we have to do is refine your
technique.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
With this, you both have strengths you can
use to appeal to prospective trainers.
We'll focus on those while we prep you for
the
tryouts!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Okay! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Did she say tryouts? Hold on...
those girls
haven't made their debuts
yet?! Tracen
students really are on another level...)

Sorry, will you be here much longer? We'd
like to use this track.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. My bad, I'll get outta your
wa—huh?

Goodness me... Are you in the middle of a
tour? Pardon us for
intruding.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
N-no, I mean, ya haven't done anything
worth pardonin'...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(...The heck? Just who...
are those two? I'm
sensin'... some sorta aura
comin' off of
'em.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey... you know anything 'bout those two?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eager to answer any questions she might
have, I explain that Oguri
Cap and Super
Creek haven't made their debuts yet,
but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff! Huff, puff! Now it's time to... surge ahead!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Not on my watch!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap & Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hraaaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(H-hey... wait a minute, what just
happened?! I thought the grey-haired girl
didn't have any fight in her, but now she
looks ready
to tear the track to shreds!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(And the big girl... It's like she's... a
bottomless pit of energy! Their
race is
totally suckin' me in—I can't look away!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Just who—or what—are they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One watches their race with bated
breath. I think it's safe to say
their partner
race has left an impression.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Four hundred meters remain! In the lead is
Oguri Cap, Oguri Cap! But
Super Creek's
right behind her and...
She takes the lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Will it be Super Creek, Oguri Cap... or
Inari One? Inari One surges to
the front!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hraaauuugh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Only two hundred meters left! Will it be
Inari One or Super Creek?
The lead goes
to...

text_block_list.name: Inari One & Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
URRRAAAUGH!
HRAAAUGH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Inari One! Inari One is ahead as she...
crosses the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The winner of that fiery showdown is none
other than Inari One! The
stands greet
their champion with a roar worthy of a
festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(A head-to-head showdown with the best
of the best... The crowd cheerin' so loud,
it's like fireworks goin' off in the
stands. Among them would be the chief and
everyone back home...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(If I could win in a place like that,
I bet
everyone would be smilin' as
they rushed
the track to—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hwaugh?! Ah... Wh-what am I thinkin'...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry, I... I gotta get home!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
...That girl. I had a feeling this would
happen...

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Nice to see ya again. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to make a small request of you.
Could you... come to Oi
Racecourse on this
day?
